scope: Local fail-closed barrier for legacy payment.pix.confirmed settlement

criteria.description: An unknown legacy PIX confirmation fails before creating or updating a transaction and cannot fabricate an amount-zero placeholder.
criteria.limitations: The proof is local and disposable; it does not certify provider or target behavior.

criteria.description: An attempt-linked transaction is rejected before mutation so B2 settlement remains owned by pix.payment.confirmed.v1 and the B1 core.
criteria.limitations: All B1 failpoints and independent live-worker crash/recovery scenarios remain outside this slice.

criteria.description: Event, payload, transaction and billing account invariants plus currency and exact amount are checked before status update or financial settlement.
criteria.limitations: This covers the shared legacy consumer boundary; it does not replace database/provider reconciliation.

criteria.description: A valid authoritative no-attempt legacy confirmation continues to settle, while the no-billing compatibility path remains a non-financial settlement.
criteria.limitations: Provider-backed refunds, chargebacks, bank settlement and broader financial reconciliation remain open.

criteria.description: Invalid legacy events propagate through the event bus so retry/DLQ semantics are preserved instead of turning invalid input into success.
criteria.limitations: The disposable worker proof does not certify all production retry, SIGKILL, observability or deployment topologies.

criteria.description: The focused consumer is wired into the official API package test command and the full local quality rails pass after the bounded change.
criteria.limitations: The unrelated consumer-registry test remains outside the API script because broad inclusion exposes a pre-existing fixture mismatch; that adjacent issue is not changed by this slice.

review.summary: Independent read-only review found no Critical, High or Medium functional finding. The only low-level condition was that the focused payment-consumer test was not part of the official API command; the script now builds the shared module and executes that test, followed by API 428/428.

conditions: Keep the legacy consumer and valid no-attempt compatibility path; do not change pix.payment.confirmed.v1 or the B1 settlement primitive without fresh authority.
Keep CVG-002B2B, the parent CVG-002 and the global ERP program IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL until provider, target, distributed worker, parity, operations and release evidence exists.
non_claims: No provider, credential, target, staging, production, deploy, commit, push or external mutation was performed.
This bounded gate is not production approval, complete ERP delivery, Vetus parity approval or release approval.
